notes: Item 19 is present and discloses substantial financial performance data for 2025. All 11 responding representative locations are multi-territory franchise owners. Data covers gross revenue (Table 1), COGS (Tables 2-3), rent (Table 4), payroll (Tables 5, 7), staffing (Table 6), revenue-per-installer (Table 8), revenue-per-sales-designer (Table 9), and individual location revenue by ownership group (Tables 10a-10b). Two OCR artifacts noted: '$1,414.933' (Table 1 median) and '$258.358' (Table 5 lowest payroll) — both interpreted as comma-separated values. Table 4 (Rent) has no median disclosed. The 'Total Responding Franchises' column in Tables 2-9 appears blank in the source for most metrics, suggesting those sub-columns were not populated. Staffing data (Table 6) not extracted as a separate record due to being non-financial headcount data. Data is unaudited per the franchisor's disclosure.
